messages:
lin: Quick check — vendor (CloudPartner) updated ETA: 10 H100s arriving Wed 2026-04-07. Can we reserve 4 for staging canary next Tue (2026-04-13)? Need a preemptible quota bump for the ephemeral pool too. cc @maya @sam

maya: on it. filing procurement ticket now. can you include the project tag and terraform resource id?

lin: project=staging-canary, tag=redwood-staging, terraform module path: `modules/gpu_pools/cloudpartner/h100.tf` resource `module.h100_pool.count = 4`

sam: FYI we're short on preemptible quota in us-west2 by ~6. who owns quota requests? @devops-team

devops-team: devops-automation-bot: created ticket INF-6123 for quota bump (requesting 10 preemptible H100s).

maya: INF-6123 linked to procurement PR #452. @lin add a quick smoke plan in the ticket.

lin: added smoke plan: 3 canary jobs, 30m each, fall back to L40s if unavailable. logs sink -> `s3://redwood-staging/canary/2026-04-13`

sam: can we also add a temporary routing rule to prefer dedicated pool for latency-sensitive requests? cc @neteng

neteng: acknowledged. we'll add a route with weight 0.8 to dedicated pool during canary window. PR created: https://git.redwood.com/neteng/route/PR-987

maya: one ask — can we get a soft-claim on the 4 GPUs in vendor portal? procurement prefers a portal hold.

lin: pinged vendor contact (Tom). he replied: 'Can hold 4 until EOD Tue if confirmed.'

sam: ok great. maya — want confirmation in INF-6123 and I'll approve the PR.

maya: confirmed, added comment and attached terraform diff. @lin can you drop the test dataset size? 50GB -> 10GB to reduce IO during canary.

lin: done. changed dataset to sample_10gb.tar.gz, updated PR and ticket.

devops-team: devops-automation-bot: quota bump approved (temporary) — INF-6123 status -> approved. Expires 2026-04-20.

lin: awesome. thanks everyone :tada: I'll schedule canary for Tue 14:00 PDT.

neteng: noted. will schedule route change 5 min before.

maya: leaving a final checklist in the ticket.
